theory: Distinguish displacement x relative to the fixed origin from change in displacement Δx over an interval. Turning around guarantees distance exceeds |Δx|, not necessarily the magnitude |x| of the final displacement from an arbitrary origin. In steps[2], v = 0 alone does not establish reversal: velocity must change sign, and not every zero-velocity instant is a turnaround.
